searchText: hey so Ignacio is currently working on it, but if you want a quick test, the kaustinen block explorer now has a "Stateless" tab when you look at a slot. If there isn't too much traffic (e.g. right now) you can send a transaction and check what the output is in the "stem" column. dora.kaustinen-testnet.ethpandaops.io you are correct, snap sync is not currently present in the testnet. When they arrive, they will indeed have some state query mechanism similar so snap sync.
